summary_markdown:
The conversation primarily revolves around the functionality and data provided by various sensors installed at different facilities. One participant confirmed that a specific sensor is now working normally, sharing its capability with others.

Later, the discussion focused on troubleshooting multiple sensors across several locations (CM_Kronen Vanløse, CM_Fisketorvet-DT07, CM_Herlev_VH02). The participants reviewed MAC addresses and facility details for these units. A key concern was raised regarding several listed sensors that appear to be non-operational or not recording data since specific dates, leading to questions about the cause of failure and whether this is normal.

One participant provided a resource link containing comprehensive sensor information.
decisions: Reviewed MAC addresses and facility details for multiple outdoor totems/sensors.
action_items: Determine the root cause for non-operational sensors at CM_Kronen Vanløse, CM_Fisketorvet-DT07, and CM_Herlev_VH02.
Confirm if the observed sensor downtime is normal or requires intervention.
